text.tspan: Plan-and-execute: the orchestrator owns and drives the plan
child runs started by the orchestrator
Plans are stored on the run with plan_* events. Approvals inside a child pause the parent; a crash resumes at the same step.

g.text: Before a plan exists only read-only tools and create_plan are offered.
Steps have ids, depends_on, and an optional agent to delegate to.
Unique ids, known dependencies, no cycles, known agents; errors go back.
The orchestrator now owns the plan.
The orchestrator starts the child runs itself; no model turn needed.
researcher and writer run at the same time.
The parent's remaining tokens and cost are shared.
Results wait in the plan's outbox for the next message.
Results and the next instruction go out as one message.
The model does its own steps one at a time.
The model is asked to revise the plan.
Unfinished steps are replaced; completed ones kept.
Execution continues with the revised plan.
All steps done: the final answer completes the run.
